name: Photograph

pages.text: Print a frame in the Lightroom, then place the photograph in an album or photograph frame.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Print a selected developed-film frame in the Lightroom. The item must retain image data; an empty photograph icon is not your actual picture.

pages.title: Storage and copies
pages.text: Open a Photo Album to arrange prints, or use a Photograph Frame. The special copying recipe preserves the image and tracks copy generation; inspect the native tooltip and JEI before spending paper.
